steps.name: 다른 요소 - 내 글 편집 + 다른 창의 채우기 → 둘 다 남고 '합쳐 저장' 알림(충돌 배너 없음)
steps.js: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'h',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); { const q=document.querySelector('#findDlg .fq'); q.value="글"; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.querySelector('#findDlg .fw').value="글자"; document.querySelector('#findDlg [data-fa="all"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); document.querySelector('#findDlg [data-fa="close"]').click(); } { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); const e=(id)=>d.slides[0].elements.find(x=>x.id===id); ((e)=>{ e('e02').fill='secondary-container'; })(e); const p=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); if(!p.ok) return 'external put '+p.status; } for (let i=0;i<40 && !(document.querySelector('#toast').textContent.includes('합쳐'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const els=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).slides[0].elements; const t=document.querySelector('#toast').textContent; return els.find(x=>x.id==='e01').text==='글자' && els.find(x=>x.id==='e02').fill==='secondary-container' && !document.querySelector('#banner.show') && t.includes('합쳐') ? true : JSON.stringify({els, t});

steps.name: Ctrl+Z - 내 편집만 되돌리고 다른 창의 변경은 남는다
steps.js: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'z',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800)); const els=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).slides[0].elements; return els.find(x=>x.id==='e01').text==='글' && els.find(x=>x.id==='e02').fill==='secondary-container' ? true : JSON.stringify(els);

steps.name: 같은 글을 동시에 - 나중 저장(내 값)이 남고 '같은 곳 1건' 알림
steps.js: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'h',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); { const q=document.querySelector('#findDlg .fq'); q.value="글"; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.querySelector('#findDlg .fw').value="안"; document.querySelector('#findDlg [data-fa="all"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); document.querySelector('#findDlg [data-fa="close"]').click(); } { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); const e=(id)=>d.slides[0].elements.find(x=>x.id===id); ((e)=>{ e('e01').text='밖'; })(e); const p=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); if(!p.ok) return 'external put '+p.status; } for (let i=0;i<40 && !(document.querySelector('#notice.show') && document.querySelector('#noticeMsg').textContent.includes('1건'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const els=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).slides[0].elements; const n=document.querySelector('#noticeMsg').textContent; return els.find(x=>x.id==='e01').text==='안' && n.includes('1건') && n.includes('내 값') ? true : JSON.stringify({els, n});

steps.name: 편집하지 않을 때 밖의 변경 → 그대로 다시 읽기(병합 없이)
steps.js: document.querySelector('#noticeClose').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); const e=(id)=>d.slides[0].elements.find(x=>x.id===id); ((e)=>{ e('e02').fill='primary-container'; })(e); const p=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); if(!p.ok) return 'external put '+p.status; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000)); const t=document.querySelector('#notice.show #noticeMsg, #toast')?.textContent||''; const els=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).slides[0].elements; return els.find(x=>x.id==='e02').fill==='primary-container' && els.find(x=>x.id==='e01').text==='안' ? true : JSON.stringify({els,t});
